newsitem.title: FINLAND: TT TIETO SAYS PLANS NO SHARE SPLIT.
newsitem.headline: TT TIETO SAYS PLANS NO SHARE SPLIT.

text.p: Finnish data systems group TT Tieto has no no plans to split its shares although it has the third highest nominal price on the Helsinki Stock Exchange, managing director Matti Lehti told Reuters on Friday.
He said the share price -- over 400 markka since January 7 and around 426.00 markka on Friday -- had not been a problem.
"We have not come across that as being a problem," he said by telephone.
"We have no current plans ... but of course I can't say what will happen in the future," he added.
Only illiquid Kone and Ford, which on Friday afternoon traded at 560.00 and at 480.00 markka respectively, cost more than TT Tieto.
